---
title: "About"
---

This is a test website for pain medicine learning modules and interactive cases. 

## Callouts

Throughout the modules, callouts are used to highlight different types of learning points.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Pause and think

A short question to help you check your understanding before reading the answer.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Key idea

The main takeaway from a section.
:::

::: {.callout-caution}
## Clinical relevance

Why the concept matters for patient assessment, imaging, procedures, or management.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## Word of caution

A common mistake, limitation, or point that should not be overinterpreted.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
## Red flag

An urgent clinical feature that should prompt timely assessment or escalation.
:::
